notes.field_vs_model: In the field, P2 and P6 (W Paces Ferry through, coordinated) have advance count zones only (no stop-bar presence); every other phase has a stop-bar Matrix zone. The model adds stop-bar presence zones on P2 (where GDOT's count zones physically are) and P6 (no field zone) so that all controllers, incl. the actuated one, read the same detectors. Right-lane zones are excluded from queue estimates ('right' in note), as at 7065.
notes.right_filter: atsc/sim/maxpressure.py and atsc/rl/agent.py drop a stop-bar zone from the queue/occupancy features when its note contains 'right' (right-turn lanes). 2026-11-16 04:20: ch69's note said 'through/right lane', so P2 had no stop-bar zone in the estimator and its queue reset to 0 every 6 s (MaxPressure starved EB). Fixed by rewording; only ch31, ch11 (right lanes) may contain it.
